title: XNPV sign-change gate removed: one bit-exact witness on build 20026
upstream_status_verbatim: XNPV wrongly inherits sign change gate
status_plain: A separate and older XNPV structural verification, on a different Excel build from the W109 identification. One witness was replayed against live Excel and agreed to the bit: OxFunc and Excel both return the same f64 bits, and OxFunc computes a value rather than publishing #NUM!, which is what confirms the sign-change precondition was wrongly inherited and correctly removed for pure discounting. This is one witness, not a count. The build here is 20026, restated on the sentence carrying the result; XNPV's W109 numeric and error-lane sign-offs are on build 20131 and a year of kernel work apart. The two must not be merged.
